name: tpl-precedence-2-goal
task: Do not drop the key while the door is closed until the door has been opened once. Reach the goal.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: `Absence(key_lost)` forbids dropping the key while the door is closed even after it has been opened once. The task forbids that only until the first opening. Replace it with hard `Precedence(door_open, key_lost)`; keep hard `Existence(at_goal)`. The environment allows `door_open` to become false again, so the event can occur after the door was opened.
NO CHANGES NEEDED: Precedence(door_open, key_lost) prevents dropping the key while the door is closed before it has first been opened, and Existence(at_goal) requires reaching the goal.

texts: key_lost does not occur before door_open has first occurred: the key is not dropped while the door is closed until the door has been opened once
at_goal holds at least once: the agent reaches the goal
